scale.likelihood: 1 Rare, 2 Unlikely, 3 Possible, 4 Likely, 5 Almost certain

limitations: This is a project-level risk register, not an enterprise risk assessment.
Scores are reasoned project estimates and are not based on production loss data.
No certification, regulatory compliance or Essential Eight maturity level is claimed.

risks.title: Credential guessing or account compromise
risks.asset: Local application identities and protected tickets
risks.threat: Repeated password attempts against a fictional or future deployed account
risks.treatment: Add MFA or federated identity before production deployment.

risks.title: Broken object or administrator authorisation
risks.threat: An authenticated user attempts to access another user's object or an administrator route
risks.treatment: Retain negative tests and review new object routes during pull requests.

risks.title: Malicious or misclassified file upload
risks.asset: Application storage, users and downstream file consumers
risks.threat: An attacker uploads content whose extension or declared MIME type hides its actual type
controls: Extension, MIME, size and signature checks
risks.treatment: Use a managed antivirus or sandbox service before production use.

risks.title: Software supply-chain compromise
risks.asset: Application dependencies, container image and release artefacts
risks.threat: A vulnerable dependency, mutable build input or compromised automation component enters a release
controls: Action references pinned to commit SHAs
risks.treatment: Continue reviewed dependency and digest updates through pull requests.

risks.title: Container privilege escalation or runtime configuration drift
risks.threat: A compromised process writes to the image, gains capabilities or runs with excess privilege
risks.treatment: Revalidate runtime policy after Compose or hosting changes.

risks.title: Credential or secret exposure in source control
risks.asset: Database password, fictional account secrets and CI credentials
risks.threat: A local secret is committed or a workflow retains credentials unnecessarily
risks.treatment: Use a managed secret store for any deployed environment.

risks.title: Security events are not detected or correlated
risks.asset: Audit trail and incident response capability
risks.threat: Credential, authorisation and upload abuse occurs without an actionable alert
risks.treatment: Forward events to a real SIEM and tune thresholds before production use.

risks.title: Database loss or unusable backup
risks.asset: PostgreSQL tickets, attachments metadata, identities and audit events
risks.threat: Data is deleted or corrupted and the available backup cannot be restored
controls: Custom-format database backup with SHA-256 validation
Clean-volume restore with schema and row-count comparison
Measured local recovery exercise and failure runbook
risks.treatment: Retain scheduled restore testing and add encrypted off-site retention before production.

risks.title: Application rollback fails during an incident or bad release
risks.threat: A faulty application version cannot be replaced by a known-good version within an acceptable time
controls: Controlled candidate failure and measured rollback exercise
risks.treatment: Retain immutable known-good image references and rehearse rollback after material deployment changes.

risks.title: Governance or compliance capability is overstated
risks.threat: Project evidence is presented as certification, enterprise compliance or a complete organisational assessment
risks.treatment: Retain limitations in final management and technical reports.
